test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'techniques'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• procedure - an established or official way of doing something.
 
• techniques - a way of carrying out a particular task, especially the execution or performance of an artistic work or a scientific procedure.
 
• capacity - the maximum amount that something can contain.
 
• delivery - the action of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would describe the the aspect of movements in dance. 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that techniques is the appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - **Dance as an artistic form of (1) expression is extremely old. Evidence of dance as a (2) creative form is available in ancient literary texts, painting and sculpture. (3) Many of the dance forms trace their roots to the (4) techniques of movement codified in the Natya Shastra (5) compiled by Bharat Muni.*
